description: This source file defines the static class `SiloRuntimeMetricsListener` for monitoring and collecting runtime metrics related to Orleans silos. It utilizes `System.Diagnostics.Metrics` to listen to metrics events such as connected clients, message sizes received, and sent, updating internal counters accordingly.

classes.name: SiloRuntimeMetricsListener
classes.description: A static class that listens to runtime metrics related to silos, particularly connection counts and message sizes, using the MeterListener from System.Diagnostics.Metrics.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the MeterListener to begin listening to metric events.

methods.name: OnMeasurementRecorded
methods.description: Callback invoked when a measurement event is recorded, updating internal counters based on the instrument.
